adds.rationale: NuScale Power's Q1 2024 disclosures show business development accelerating with hyperscale/data-center prospects amid the buildout of AI power demand, giving the nuclear wave a fission-SMR reactor-technology name to complement the uranium-miner exposure (CCJ) already held; listed on NYSE since May 2022, ample liquidity and price history.

news_evidence.summary: NuScale Q1 2024 earnings release: 'Business development activity accelerated as customer conversations advanced, particularly in the data center/AI sector'
NuScale Q1 2024: RoPower authorized Phase 2 Front-End Engineering and Design study for the Doicesti SMR power plant in Romania

rationale_overall: No removals this quarter. Existing rockets (RKLB, LUNR, AVAV), robotics/automation (ISRG, ROK), quantum (IONQ), nuclear/uranium (CCJ), defense (ITA, LMT, GD), and tanker (FRO) exposures all showed stable-to-improving fundamentals in the trailing 90 days: RKLB's Q1 2024 revenue grew 69% YoY; AVAV's fiscal Q4 2024 (reported June 26) beat with record revenue; ISRG's Q1 2024 procedure volume grew 16%; IONQ beat Q1 revenue guidance and raised full-year bookings; FRO posted strong VLCC spot rates off the Euronav integration; GD's backlog grew 4.4% YoY and LMT's backlog remained near $160B. Rockwell (ROK) posted a soft fiscal Q2 (organic sales -8.1% on customer destocking) — a cyclical air pocket rather than a thesis breach, so it stays pending confirmation. One add: NuScale Power (SMR) fills the nuclear wave's SMR/reactor-technology gap (previously only uranium-miner CCJ) on accelerating data-center/AI customer conversations, without relying on post-date PPA news. Candidates passed over: RGTI/QBTS (only modest revenue, dilutive raises), GE Vernova (too little trading history since its April 2024 spinoff), Symbotic (no dated in-window news).
